correctness.rationale: The source definitions and the complete proof of Lemma 3.2 were reconstructed from the publisher PDF and checked against the public preprint. For closed-range \(K\), the reconstruction associated with \(K^\dagger F\) is exactly \(S_F(K^\dagger)^*\). Moore--Penrose identities give the two-way equivalence with \(S_FP_{R(K)}=KK^*\). The scalar one-point example satisfies every substantive hypothesis of the source's printed \(A=B=1\) convention and directly violates the dual identity.

value.rationale: The disputed lemma is the entry point for the paper's pseudo-inverse-generated canonical dual construction. Under the printed definition it fails already in one dimension. The exact identity \(S_FP_{R(K)}=KK^*\) isolates the minimal operator condition needed for the proposed dual, is strictly weaker than the later blanket repair \(S_F=KK^*\), and clarifies which part of the frame operator actually matters.
